name: Daniel Smart Manufacturing Inc

about:
Daniel Smart Manufacturing Inc operates from Baltimore, Maryland, where it was founded in 1975. The company has served motorcycle riders for nearly five decades, though the input does not specify its ownership structure or founders.

The business functions as a retailer and wholesaler of leather motorcycle gear, textile apparel, and accessories. Its product range includes jackets, vests, flannels, pants, chaps, boots, rain suits, helmets, and saddle bags. A custom builder tool and embroidery patch service allow buyers to personalize items. The company reports more than four million customers since 1975 and over 35,000 reviews across platforms.

Customers span individual riders and wholesale buyers such as dealers and shops in the powersports industry. The company serves the motorcycle apparel and leather goods markets, offering both stocked and customizable products.

Daniel Smart emphasizes communication and customer service, promoting a 30‑day easy return and exchange policy. The brand positions itself on delivering premium gear at competitive prices, though no specific founding mission is detailed in the source material.
